name: paperclip
description: Official @paperclipai/mcp-server integration for Paperclip (issue/agent management). Thin MCP wrapper over the paperclip REST API: 30+ typed tools (paperclipMe, paperclipListIssues, paperclipCreateIssue, ...) plus the paperclipApiRequest escape hatch for endpoints without a dedicated tool yet.

config_schema.label: Paperclip API URL
config_schema.description: Base URL of the paperclip REST API (service name inside the omni-stack compose network)

config_schema.label: Paperclip API Key
config_schema.description: Bearer token for the paperclip /api endpoints. Create in the paperclip UI (Settings -> API keys / agent API keys) and provide via plugin config ($secret: ref).

config_schema.label: Company ID
config_schema.description: Optional company id for multi-company paperclip instances

config_schema.label: Agent ID
config_schema.description: Optional agent id (used by agent-scoped paperclip features)

config_schema.label: Run ID
config_schema.description: Optional run id (used by agent-scoped paperclip features)
